observations: Photo 0 shows a black keyboard with 61 keys, labeled 'Roland E-96 Intelligent Keyboard' on the left side.
The keys are visibly worn, with some white keys showing discoloration and damage.
The surface of the keyboard has dust, smudges, and minor scratches, especially on the right side.
Photo 1 shows a metal label on the back of the unit: 'MUSICAL INSTRUMENT', 'MODEL E-96', 'SERIAL NO. Z108905', 'MADE IN ITALY', 'ROLAND EUROPE spa'.
Photo 2 shows a close-up of the control panel, including the display screen, knobs, and buttons. The screen is dark and unlit, suggesting the unit is off or not powered.
The brand 'Roland' is visible on the screen bezel in photo 2.
All photos have a watermark 'AUTO ZENITH PARTS'.

claims.claim: US imported Roland E-96 Intelligent Keyboard
claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows 'MADE IN ITALY', not US. The 'imported' claim cannot be verified from photos alone.

risks.risk: The keyboard may not power on or function properly.
risks.proof: A video showing the keyboard powering on, display lighting up, and keys producing sound.

risks.risk: The keys may be damaged or unresponsive due to visible wear and discoloration.
risks.proof: Close-up video of each key being pressed to check for response and physical damage.

risks.risk: Internal components may be faulty or degraded due to age or storage conditions.
risks.proof: Video of the unit being tested with all functions (sound, effects, memory, etc.) and a visual inspection of internal components if possible.

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powering on and playing a note.
Close-up video of all keys being pressed to check for damage or unresponsiveness.
Video showing all functions (e.g., sound, effects, memory, display) working.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified as Roland E-96, but the functional state is unknown. The keys show visible wear, and the screen is off in the photos. Without proof of working condition, the item cannot be priced accurately and must be tested.
